مقطع محوري طبيعي للبطن مع صبغة وريدية وف: Normal axial section of the abdomen with intravenous and oral contrast in the portal venous phase.
الكبد والطحال متجانسان، والكليتان تعززان: The liver and spleen are homogeneous, the kidneys enhance equally, the bowel is filled with oral contrast, and there is no free air or fluid.
التهاب الزائدة الدودية وانتفاخها، أشيع س: Inflammation and swelling of the appendix; the most common surgical cause of acute abdominal pain.
زائدة متوسّعة (قطرها أكثر من 6 ملم) بجدا: A dilated appendix (diameter more than 6 mm) with a thick wall and surrounding fat stranding; here a retrocaecal appendix measured with the ruler.
انسداد يمنع مرور محتوى الأمعاء الدقيقة،: An obstruction that blocks the passage of small-bowel contents; its most common cause is postoperative adhesions.
عُرى أمعاء دقيقة متوسّعة مليئة بالسائل ق: Dilated, fluid-filled small-bowel loops before the transition point, with empty, collapsed bowel beyond it.
التهاب جيوب صغيرة (رتوج) في جدار القولون: Inflammation of small pouches (diverticula) in the colonic wall, usually in the sigmoid colon in older people.
جدار القولون السيني سميك مع رتوج صغيرة ت: The sigmoid colon wall is thickened, with small air-containing diverticula, and the surrounding fat is stranded by inflammation.
هواء حر داخل جوف البطن خارج الأمعاء، أشي: Free air inside the abdominal cavity outside the bowel; its most common cause is perforation of the stomach or bowel.
هواء أسود تحت جدار البطن الأمامي فوق الك: Black air beneath the anterior abdominal wall, above the liver and bowel (because the patient is supine); it is seen more clearly on a lung window.
حصاة عالقة في الحالب تسبب المغص الكلوي؛: A stone lodged in the ureter causing renal colic; non-contrast CT (CT KUB) is the most accurate test.
نقطة بيضاء جداً (عالية الكثافة) داخل مسا: A very white (high-density) dot within the course of the right proximal ureter (at the arrow); the source states it causes mild obstruction with dilatation of the renal pelvis (hydronephrosis).
بدون صبغة، بجرعة منخفضة (low-dose CT KUB: Without contrast, at low dose (low-dose CT KUB)

بنكرياس متضخّم تحيطه سوائل ودهون مشوّشة: An enlarged pancreas surrounded by fluid and stranded fat (peripancreatic fluid / fat stranding).
تمزّق في الطحال بعد إصابة البطن، أشيع عض: A tear in the spleen after abdominal injury; the spleen is the most commonly injured organ in blunt abdominal trauma.
منطقة داكنة غير منتظمة داخل نسيج الطحال: An irregular dark area within the contrast-enhanced splenic tissue (laceration), which may be surrounded by blood.
أشيع ورم حميد في الكبد، يتكوّن من أوعية: The most common benign liver tumour; it is made of blood vessels and is usually found incidentally.
آفة صغيرة محددة الحواف داخل الكبد (عند ا: A small well-defined lesion within the liver (at the arrow) whose density differs from the surrounding liver tissue.
مفراس متعدد الأطوار: نمطها المميز تعزيز: Multiphase CT: its characteristic pattern is peripheral nodular enhancement that gradually fills in towards the centre on the delayed phase
أورام منتشرة إلى الكبد من سرطان في عضو آ: Tumours spread to the liver from a cancer in another organ (most commonly the colon); the most common malignant liver tumours.
عقد متعددة منخفضة الكثافة (hypodense) مخ: Multiple hypodense nodules of different sizes scattered through the liver (and here in the spleen as well).

الأبهر البطني أمام جسم الفقرة متوسّع بشك: The abdominal aorta in front of the vertebral body is clearly dilated and round compared with its normal diameter, and its wall may be lined by mural thrombus that is less dense than the contrast.

خثرة دموية (غالباً من أوردة الساق) تسدّ: A blood clot (usually from the leg veins) blocking the pulmonary artery or its branches.

خط رفيع داكن (intimal flap) داخل الأبهر: A thin dark line (intimal flap) inside the contrast-filled aorta dividing it into two lumens: true and false.

تجمّع سائل في الحيّز الجنبي بين الرئة وج: A collection of fluid in the pleural space between the lung and the chest wall.
سائل رمادي متجانس هلالي الشكل في الجزء ا: Homogeneous, crescent-shaped grey fluid in the posterior part of the chest (because the patient is supine), compressing the adjacent lung.
هواء في الحيّز الجنبي يفصل الرئة عن جدار: Air in the pleural space separating the lung from the chest wall.
منطقة سوداء تماماً بلا أوعية رئوية بين ج: A completely black area with no lung vessels between the chest wall and the edge of the collapsed lung; CT detects even a small pneumothorax.
تحطّم جدران الأسناخ الهوائية فتتكوّن فرا: Destruction of the alveolar walls, forming air spaces in the lung; its best-known cause is smoking.
بقع داكنة صغيرة بلا جدار واضح (low atten: Small dark areas without a visible wall (low attenuation areas) scattered through the upper lobes, with normal lung tissue between them.
امتلاء الأسناخ الهوائية بالسائل الالتهاب: Filling of the alveoli with inflammatory fluid in a lobe of the lung due to infection.
منطقة بيضاء كثيفة (consolidation) محددة: A dense white area (consolidation) bounded by the lobe's borders; the bronchi may appear black within it (air bronchogram).
ورم خبيث في الرئة يظهر كتلة؛ المفراس يحد: A malignant lung tumour appearing as a mass; CT defines its size and its relationship to the bronchi and vessels.
كتلة نسيجية كبيرة غير منتظمة الحواف في ا: A large soft-tissue mass with irregular margins in the left lower lobe, narrowing the adjacent bronchus and artery.
مقطع محوري (axial) طبيعي للدماغ بدون صبغ: Normal axial section of the brain without contrast, against which we compare all head cases.
المادة الرمادية أفتح قليلاً من المادة ال: Grey matter is slightly brighter than white matter, the ventricles are symmetrical, the midline is straight, and normal blood does not appear outside the vessels.
تجمّع دم بين الأم الجافية (dura) والأم ا: A collection of blood between the dura and the arachnoid mater, usually occurring after injury in older people.
تجمّع هلالي الشكل (crescent) على سطح نصف: A crescent-shaped collection over the surface of the cerebral hemisphere that crosses suture lines (high density when acute) and pushes the midline to the opposite side.
تجمّع دم بين عظم الجمجمة والأم الجافية،: A collection of blood between the skull bone and the dura, usually from a torn artery after a skull fracture.
تجمّع عالي الكثافة محدّب من الجهتين (bic: A high-density collection that is convex on both sides (biconvex / lentiform), directly beneath the bone, not crossing suture lines, with midline shift.
دفع الدماغ والخط الأوسط إلى الجهة الأخرى: Displacement of the brain and midline to the opposite side because of haemorrhage, oedema or a mass; a sign of severity.
الحاجز الشفاف (septum pellucidum) والمنج: The septum pellucidum and falx are deviated from the midline, and the lateral ventricle on the affected side is compressed.
زيادة السائل الدماغي الشوكي (CSF) داخل ا: An increase of cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) within the ventricles, so the ventricles dilate.
البطينات الجانبية والبطين الثالث متوسّعة: The lateral ventricles and third ventricle are clearly dilated and ballooned compared with the normal or effaced size of the sulci.
في الساعات الأولى من الجلطة الدماغية قد: In the first hours of a stroke the brain may look normal, but the clot within the artery appears white.
الشريان الدماغي الأوسط (MCA) أبيض وعالي: The middle cerebral artery (MCA) is white and hyperdense compared with the other side because of the clot inside it, with slight loss of grey–white matter differentiation.

بعد أيام من انسداد الشريان يموت النسيج ا: Days after an artery is blocked, the brain tissue in its territory dies and appears dark.
منطقة منخفضة الكثافة (hypodense) واسعة ب: A large hypodense area in an arterial territory (the MCA territory) involving the cortex and white matter, with loss of differentiation between them.
نزف داخل نسيج الدماغ، أشهر أسبابه ارتفاع: Bleeding within the brain tissue; its best-known cause is hypertension and its common site is the basal ganglia.
كتلة دم بيضاء عالية الكثافة داخل الدماغ: A white, high-density mass of blood within the brain surrounded by a dark halo of oedema; the blood may extend into the ventricles.
دم في الحيّز تحت العنكبوتية حول الدماغ،: Blood in the subarachnoid space around the brain; its best-known non-traumatic cause is rupture of a cerebral aneurysm.
كثافة بيضاء تملأ الصهاريج القاعدية (basa: White density filling the basal cisterns, Sylvian fissures and sulci instead of the normal black of the fluid.

كسر في عظم الجمجمة بعد إصابة الرأس؛ يُرى: A fracture of the skull bone after head injury; it is seen more clearly on a bone window.
انقطاع في القشرة العظمية مع قطع عظمية مت: A break in the bone cortex with multiple (comminuted) bone fragments depressed inwards, overlying the extradural haemorrhage in this case.
نافذة العظم (bone window) ضرورية؛ والتشك: A bone window is essential; 3D reconstruction shows the fracture lines

جسم الفقرة مفتّت إلى قطع متعددة في المقط: The vertebral body is shattered into multiple fragments on the axial section, with a bone fragment displaced backwards (retropulsion) towards the spinal canal.

القناة الشوكية خلف الأقراص ضيّقة عند أكث: The spinal canal behind the discs is narrow at more than one level (here L3/4 and L4/5) compared with the normal levels.

أورام ثانوية وصلت للدماغ عن طريق الدم من: Secondary tumours that reached the brain through the blood from a cancer elsewhere (such as the breast or lung).

خروج الكعبرة والزند معاً للخلف خلف العضد: Displacement of both the radius and ulna backwards behind the humerus; it is the most common type of elbow dislocation.
الزج (olecranon) ورأس الكعبرة واقعان خلف: The olecranon and radial head lie behind the end of the humerus (distal humerus) instead of facing it, with no visible fracture.
AP و lateral، ثم صورة بعد الرد للتأكد من: AP and lateral, then an image after reduction to make sure there is no associated fracture

كسر في جسم الزند (ulna)، ورأس الكعبرة (r: A fracture of the ulnar shaft, and the radial head does not face the capitellum as it should.
الساعد كاملاً مع المرفق والرسغ بإسقاطين: The whole forearm with the elbow and wrist in two projections
كسر في ثلث الكعبرة البعيد مع خلع المفصل: A fracture of the distal third of the radius with dislocation of the distal radioulnar joint (DRUJ) at the wrist.
كسر في جسم الكعبرة البعيد (distal radius: A fracture of the distal radius shaft with angulation, and the distal end of the ulna is separated from the radius.
الساعد AP و lateral مع الرسغ؛ الجانبية ت: Forearm AP and lateral with the wrist; the lateral shows the ulnar dislocation
انصباب داخل مفصل المرفق يرفع الوسائد الد: An effusion within the elbow joint lifts the fat pads, and with an injury it indicates a fracture that may not be visible.
الوسادة الدهنية الأمامية (anterior fat p: The anterior fat pad is elevated in a sail shape, and the posterior fat pad is visible behind the humerus on the lateral image.
Elbow lateral حقيقي والمرفق مثني 90° (وإ: A true elbow lateral with the elbow flexed 90° (otherwise the posterior fat pad may appear falsely)
صورة كاحل طبيعية لبالغ بالإسقاط الأمامي: A normal adult ankle X-ray in the anteroposterior (AP) projection, against which we compare malleolar fractures.
الكعب الإنسي (medial malleolus) والكعب ا: The medial malleolus and lateral malleolus have continuous cortices, the medial clear space of the mortise is open, and the tip of the fibula overlaps the talus normally.
صورة كاحل طبيعية بإسقاط الـ Mortise (دور: A normal ankle image in the mortise projection (15–20° internal rotation), against which we compare mortise widening and fibular fractures.
المسافة بين عظم الكاحل (talus) والكعبين: The space between the talus and the malleoli is equal around the talar dome on both sides, and the roof of the mortise (tibial plafond) is smooth.
صورة كاحل طبيعية بالإسقاط الجانبي، نقارن: A normal ankle image in the lateral projection, against which we compare fractures of the posterior malleolus and the talus.
الشظية فوق النصف الخلفي من الظنبوب، وقبة: The fibula lies over the posterior half of the tibia, the talar dome is congruent, and the posterior edge of the tibia (posterior malleolus) is intact.
صورة قدم طبيعية بالإسقاط الظهري الأخمصي: A normal foot image in the dorsoplantar (DP) projection, against which we compare metatarsal fractures and the Lisfranc joint.
الحافة الإنسية لقاعدة المشط الثاني على ا: The medial edge of the base of the second metatarsal is in line with the medial edge of the intermediate cuneiform, and the metatarsophalangeal joints are open and regular.
صورة قدم طبيعية بالإسقاط المائل الإنسي،: A normal foot image in the medial oblique projection, against which we compare fractures of the base of the fifth metatarsal.
قواعد الأمشاط الثالث إلى الخامس تظهر بلا: The bases of the third to fifth metatarsals are seen without overlap, and the medial edge of the base of the fourth metatarsal is in line with the medial edge of the cuboid.
صورة قدم طبيعية بالإسقاط الجانبي، نقارن: A normal foot image in the lateral projection, against which we compare the arch of the foot and the calcaneus.
القوس الطولي (longitudinal arch) واضح، و: The longitudinal arch is clear, and the talus, navicular and first metatarsal lie roughly on one line.
صورة عقب طبيعية بالإسقاط الجانبي، نقارن: A normal calcaneus image in the lateral projection, against which we compare calcaneal fractures and calcaneal spurs.
عظم العقب (calcaneus) بشكله الكامل، والم: The calcaneus is seen in its full shape, the subtalar joint and sinus tarsi are open, and Böhler's angle is measured from it.
صورة عقب طبيعية بالإسقاط المحوري (planto: A normal calcaneus image in the axial (plantodorsal) projection, showing the body of the calcaneus from below.
حدبة العقب (calcaneal tuberosity) والحاف: The calcaneal tuberosity and the medial and lateral margins are continuous, with no angular deformity.
كسر في أسفل الشظية (distal fibula) عند م: A fracture of the distal fibula at the level of the tibiofibular ligament (syndesmosis); it is the most common ankle fracture.
خط كسر مائل في الكعب الوحشي يبدأ عند مست: An oblique fracture line in the lateral malleolus starting at the level of the roof of the mortise; the distal fragment may be displaced laterally.
AP + mortise + lateral؛ والجانبية تُظهر: AP + mortise + lateral; the lateral shows the obliquity of the fracture line
كسر في الكعب الوحشي تحت مستوى الرباط الظ: A fracture of the lateral malleolus below the level of the tibiofibular ligament (infrasyndesmotic); it is usually stable.
خط كسر أفقي (عرضي) في طرف الكعب الوحشي،: A horizontal (transverse) fracture line at the tip of the lateral malleolus, below the level of the ankle joint.
كسر في الشظية فوق مستوى الرباط الظنبوبي: A fracture of the fibula above the level of the tibiofibular ligament (suprasyndesmotic), so the ligament is torn and the ankle is usually unstable.
خط كسر في جسم الشظية أعلى من سقف النقرة: A fracture line in the fibular shaft several centimetres above the roof of the mortise; the space between the tibia and fibula may widen.
كسر في الكعب الإنسي (medial malleolus) و: A fracture of both the medial malleolus and the lateral malleolus, making the ankle joint unstable.
خطا كسر: واحد في أسفل الشظية وآخر في الك: Two fracture lines: one in the distal fibula and another in the medial malleolus, with displacement of the talus from the mortise in this image.
كسر في الكعب الوحشي والإنسي والخلفي (pos: A fracture of the lateral, medial and posterior malleoli together; it is an unstable fracture.
كسر مفتّت في أسفل الشظية مع كسر الكعب ال: Comminuted fracture of the distal fibula with a medial malleolus fracture; the posterior malleolus is seen more clearly on the lateral view.
Lateral ankle ضرورية لرؤية الكعب الخلفي: Lateral ankle is essential to see the posterior malleolus
اقتلاع (avulsion) جزء من حدبة قاعدة المش: Avulsion of part of the tuberosity at the base of the fifth metatarsal; it is more common than a Jones fracture and usually heals well.
خط شفاف أفقي (radiolucent line) في حدبة: A horizontal radiolucent line in the tuberosity at the base of the fifth metatarsal, close to its tip.
Foot oblique تُظهر قاعدة المشط الخامس بل: Foot oblique shows the base of the fifth metatarsal without overlap
كسر عرضي في المشط الخامس عند الوصل بين ا: A transverse fracture of the fifth metatarsal at the junction of the base and the shaft (metadiaphyseal junction), a poorly vascularised area, so healing is delayed.
خط كسر عرضي على بعد نحو 2 سم من قاعدة ال: A transverse fracture line about 2 cm from the base of the fifth metatarsal, distal to the tuberosity.
كسر في عظم العقب (calcaneus)، غالباً بعد: A fracture of the calcaneus, usually after a fall from a height onto the feet.
تشوّه وتفتّت في جسم العقب في الصورة الجا: Deformity and comminution of the calcaneal body on the lateral view; the Böhler angle here is 22° according to the source, and the source (Radiopaedia) states that the normal range is 25°–40° and that a reduced angle accompanies displaced intra-articular fractures.
Calcaneus axial (Harris) + CT لتقييم الم: Calcaneus axial (Harris) + CT to assess the subtalar joint
كسر صغير ينتج من ضغط متكرر (مشي طويل أو: A small fracture caused by repetitive stress (long walking or training), most commonly in the neck of the second or third metatarsal.
قد تكون الصورة الأولى طبيعية؛ وبعد أيام: The first X-ray may be normal; after some days periosteal new bone appears around the metatarsal neck.
إذا الصورة طبيعية والألم مستمر: إعادة ال: If the X-ray is normal and pain persists: repeat the X-ray after 10–14 days, or MRI / bone scan
إصابة المفاصل الرصغية المشطية (tarsometa: Injury to the tarsometatarsal joints and the ligament between the medial cuneiform and the base of the second metatarsal.
اتساع المسافة بين قاعدة المشط الأول والث: Widening of the space between the bases of the first and second metatarsals (Lisfranc interval), seen more clearly on the weight-bearing view; a small fragment may be present (fleck sign).
Weight-bearing DP ومقارنة القدم الثانية: Weight-bearing DP and comparison with the other foot
كسر في أعلى الشظية (proximal fibula) يرا: A fracture of the proximal fibula accompanied by an unstable ankle injury (ligament tear or medial malleolus fracture).
خط كسر في الثلث العلوي من الشظية قرب الر: A fracture line in the upper third of the fibula near the knee; therefore, when there is a medial ankle injury with no distal fibular fracture, we image the whole leg.
Full-length tib/fib AP + lateral مع صور: Full-length tib/fib AP + lateral with the ankle views
كسر في عنق عظم الكاحل (talus)، غالباً بع: A fracture of the neck of the talus, usually after high-energy trauma such as motorcycle accidents, and it threatens the blood supply of the bone.
خط كسر أو انضغاط في عنق عظم الكاحل بين ا: A fracture line or compression in the talar neck between the dome and the head on the lateral view, with soft-tissue swelling.
كسر في أسفل الظنبوب عند المراهقين يمر بث: A fracture of the distal tibia in adolescents that runs in three planes through the growth plate (physis); it is a type of Salter-Harris IV.
في الصورة الأمامية خط كسر عمودي في المشا: On the AP view, a vertical fracture line in the epiphysis (Salter-Harris III), and on the lateral view a fracture of the metaphysis (Salter-Harris II).
Lateral ankle + CT للتخطيط الجراحي: Lateral ankle + CT for surgical planning
انحراف إبهام القدم نحو الأصابع الأخرى مع: Deviation of the big toe towards the other toes, with medial angulation of the first metatarsal and a medial bony prominence (bunion).
زيادة الزاوية بين المشط الأول والثاني (i: An increased angle between the first and second metatarsals (intermetatarsal angle) and lateral deviation of the proximal phalanx of the big toe, with a bony prominence on the medial side.
Weight-bearing DP لقياس الزوايا: Weight-bearing DP to measure the angles
ترسّب بلورات حمض اليوريك (urate crystals: Deposition of urate crystals around the joint; the most common site is the joint of the big toe.
تآكل قرب المفصل (juxta-articular erosion: Juxta-articular erosion of the first metatarsal head on the medial side, with overlying soft-tissue swelling.
هبوط القوس الطولي للقدم (longitudinal ar: Collapse of the longitudinal arch of the foot, so almost the entire sole touches the ground.
في الصورة الجانبية مع تحميل الوزن ينخفض: On the weight-bearing lateral view the longitudinal arch is lowered and the space under the midfoot is reduced.
نتوء عظمي (enthesophyte) في أسفل عظم الع: A bony outgrowth (enthesophyte) on the underside of the calcaneus at the origin of the plantar fascia; common with advancing age.
نتوء عظمي مدبّب يخرج من الحافة السفلية ا: A pointed bony outgrowth arising from the anterior inferior margin of the calcaneal tuberosity on the lateral view.
عظم إضافي صغير خلف عظم الكاحل، وهو تغيّر: A small accessory bone behind the talus; it is a normal variant and is not a fracture.
قطعة عظمية مستطيلة ملساء الحواف (well-co: An oblong, well-corticated bony fragment behind the talus on the lateral view; its smooth margins distinguish it from a fracture.
صورة يد طبيعية لبالغ بالإسقاط الخلفي الأ: A normal adult hand X-ray in the posteroanterior (PA) projection, used for comparison with hand and finger cases.
الأمشاط (metacarpals) والسلاميات (phalan: The metacarpals and phalanges have a smooth, continuous cortex, and the interphalangeal and metacarpophalangeal joints are open and even.
صورة يد طبيعية بالإسقاط المائل (PA obliq: A normal hand X-ray in the oblique projection (PA oblique), showing the metacarpals without complete overlap.
أجسام الأمشاط 3–5 متراكبة قليلاً، والثان: The shafts of metacarpals 3–5 overlap slightly, the second and third are separate, and the interphalangeal joints are open.
صورة يد طبيعية بالإسقاط الجانبي (lateral: A normal hand X-ray in the lateral projection, showing whether fractures are displaced anteriorly or posteriorly.
الأمشاط والسلاميات متراكبة، ونهايتا الكع: The metacarpals and phalanges are superimposed, the distal ends of the radius and ulna are superimposed, and the thumb is seen without superimposition.
صورة رسغ طبيعية لبالغ بالإسقاط الخلفي ال: A normal adult wrist X-ray in the posteroanterior (PA) projection, used for comparison with wrist fractures and dislocations.
عظام الرسغ (carpal bones) مصفوفة بثلاثة: The carpal bones are aligned in three smooth arcs (Gilula arcs), the spaces between them are equal (about 2 mm), and the distal radius is intact.
صورة رسغ طبيعية بالإسقاط الجانبي (latera: A normal wrist X-ray in the lateral projection, the most important view for radial fractures and lunate dislocations.
الكعبرة والهلالي (lunate) والكبير (capit: The radius, lunate and capitate lie in one line, and the articular surface of the radius tilts slightly forwards (volar tilt).
صورة إبهام طبيعية بالإسقاط الخلفي الأمام: A normal thumb X-ray in the posteroanterior (PA) projection, used for comparison with fractures of the base of the first metacarpal.
قاعدة المشط الأول (1st metacarpal base): The base of the first metacarpal (1st metacarpal base) meets the trapezium at a regular joint, and the joints are open.
صورة إبهام طبيعية بالإسقاط الجانبي (late: A normal thumb X-ray in the lateral projection.
السلاميتان والمشط الأول على خط واحد بدون: The two phalanges and the first metacarpal are in line without displacement, and the interphalangeal and metacarpophalangeal joints are open.
كسر في نهاية الكعبرة (distal radius) مع: A fracture of the distal radius with dorsal tilt of the distal fragment, usually after a fall on an outstretched hand.
خط كسر عرضي قرب نهاية الكعبرة، وفي الصور: A transverse fracture line near the distal end of the radius; on the lateral view the distal fragment tilts backwards (dorsal angulation), giving a dinner-fork appearance; it may be accompanied by a fracture of the ulnar styloid.
Lateral wrist ضرورية لتحديد اتجاه الإزاح: Lateral wrist is essential to determine the direction of displacement
أشيع كسر بعظام الرسغ (carpal bones)، يحد: The most common carpal bone fracture; it occurs after a fall on an outstretched hand and may not be visible on the first X-ray.
خط شفاف (lucent line) يعبر خصر العظم الز: A lucent line crossing the scaphoid waist; if the X-ray is normal and pain is present, it is repeated after 10–14 days.
Scaphoid series: PA بانحراف زندي (ulnar: Scaphoid series: PA with ulnar deviation + Oblique + Lateral, or the Stecher method (Bontrager)
كسر في عنق المشط الخامس (5th metacarpal: A fracture of the neck of the fifth metacarpal (5th metacarpal neck), usually after punching a hard object.
خط كسر قرب رأس المشط الخامس، والرأس مائل: A fracture line near the head of the fifth metacarpal, with the head angled towards the palm (volar angulation) and mild shortening; the angulation is seen more clearly on the oblique or lateral view.
Hand PA + Oblique + Lateral لقياس الميلا: Hand PA + Oblique + Lateral to measure the angulation
كسر في نهاية الكعبرة تميل فيه القطعة الب: A fracture of the distal radius in which the distal fragment tilts towards the palm, the opposite of a Colles fracture.
في الصورة الجانبية تنزاح القطعة البعيدة: On the lateral view the distal radial fragment is displaced anteriorly (volar displacement), and the fracture is extra-articular.
Lateral wrist ضرورية لتمييزه عن كسر كولس: Lateral wrist is essential to distinguish it from a Colles fracture
كسر في إحدى سلاميات الأصابع (phalanges)،: A fracture of one of the finger phalanges, among the most common hand fractures.
خط كسر شفاف رفيع في جسم السلامية الدانية: A thin lucent fracture line in the shaft of the proximal phalanx without displacement; the three follow-up images show the line becoming clearer and then callus forming.
Finger PA + Oblique + true Lateral للإصب: Finger PA + Oblique + true Lateral of the injured finger alone
كسر في الحافة الأمامية أو الخلفية لنهاية: A fracture of the anterior or posterior rim of the distal radius extending into the joint, with the carpus displaced along with it.
قطعة من الحافة الأمامية للكعبرة (volar r: A fragment of the anterior rim of the radius (volar rim) is broken within the joint (intra-articular), and the carpal bones are displaced anteriorly with it.
Lateral wrist تبيّن الحافة المكسورة؛ وCT: Lateral wrist shows the fractured rim; and CT for surgical planning
كسر في قاعدة المشط الأول (1st metacarpal: A fracture of the base of the first metacarpal (1st metacarpal base) extending into the carpometacarpal joint, with only two fragments.
قطعة صغيرة تبقى بمكانها عند الجهة الإنسي: A small fragment stays in place at the medial side of the base of the first metacarpal, while the rest of the metacarpal is displaced laterally and proximally.
اقتلاع وتر الباسطة (extensor tendon) من: Avulsion of the extensor tendon from the base of the distal phalanx with a bone fragment, so the fingertip stays flexed.
قطعة عظمية صغيرة من الوجه الخلفي (dorsal: A small bony fragment from the dorsal aspect of the base of the distal phalanx on the lateral view, with the distal phalanx flexed.
True lateral للإصبع المصاب وحده: True lateral of the injured finger alone
تمزّق الرباط الجانبي الزندي (ulnar colla: A tear of the ulnar collateral ligament of the thumb metacarpophalangeal joint, which may avulse a bone fragment.
قطعة عظمية صغيرة مقتلعة (avulsion) من ال: A small avulsed bony fragment from the ulnar side of the base of the proximal phalanx of the thumb.
Thumb PA + Lateral؛ وStress view (بعد اس: Thumb PA + Lateral; and a stress view (after excluding a fracture) at the doctor's request
كسر مفتّت (comminuted) في قاعدة المشط ال: A comminuted fracture of the base of the first metacarpal extending into the joint, with three or more fragments.
قاعدة المشط الأول مكسورة لعدة قطع على شك: The base of the first metacarpal is broken into several fragments in a T or Y shape, and the line reaches the carpometacarpal joint.
Thumb AP (طريقة Robert) + Lateral؛ وCT ع: Thumb AP (Robert method) + Lateral; and CT when needed
ثاني أشيع كسر بعظام الرسغ بعد الزورقي، و: The second most common carpal fracture after the scaphoid, usually a small flake from the dorsum of the bone.
قشرة عظمية صغيرة (dorsal flake) خلف عظام: A small bony flake (dorsal flake) behind the carpal bones, seen only on the lateral view.
Lateral wrist (القشرة لا تظهر في PA غالب: Lateral wrist (the flake is usually not seen on the PA)
كسر شائع عند الأطفال تنبعج فيه قشرة العظ: A common fracture in children in which the bone cortex buckles instead of breaking.
انتفاخ أو تجعّد صغير بقشرة الكعبرة (cort: A small bulge or wrinkle in the radial cortex (cortical buckle) near its distal end, seen more clearly on the lateral view.
خلع يبقى فيه العظم الهلالي (lunate) بمكا: A dislocation in which the lunate stays in place on the radius while the rest of the carpal bones are displaced dorsally; it is often accompanied by a scaphoid fracture.
في الصورة الجانبية الهلالي على الكعبرة،: On the lateral view the lunate sits on the radius, but the capitate is displaced behind it; on the AP the carpal bones overlap and the scaphoid is fractured.
True lateral wrist ضرورية للتشخيص: True lateral wrist is essential for diagnosis
خلع ينقلب فيه العظم الهلالي وينزاح نحو ا: A dislocation in which the lunate tips over and is displaced towards the palm, while the rest of the carpus stays aligned with the radius.
في الصورة الجانبية الهلالي منزاح للأمام: On the lateral view the lunate is displaced anteriorly and tilted like a spilled teacup (spilled teacup sign), while the capitate remains in line with the radius.
تمزّق الرباط بين الزورقي والهلالي (scaph: A tear of the scapholunate ligament, so the gap between the scaphoid and lunate widens.
مسافة واسعة بين الزورقي والهلالي في صورة: A wide gap between the scaphoid and lunate on the PA view (more than about 3 mm), called the Terry Thomas sign.
PA مع قبضة اليد مشدودة (clenched fist) ل: PA with a clenched fist to show the widening
تآكل غضروف المفاصل مع العمر، ويصيب خاصة: Wear of joint cartilage with age, affecting especially the distal finger joints and the base of the thumb.
تضيّق المفاصل بين السلاميات البعيدة (DIP: Narrowing of the distal interphalangeal (DIP) joints with osteophytes and subchondral sclerosis; bone density is normal.
Both hands PA على كاسيت واحد للمقارنة: Both hands PA on one cassette for comparison
مرض مناعي مزمن يلتهب فيه غشاء المفاصل، و: A chronic autoimmune disease in which the joint lining (synovium) becomes inflamed; it affects both hands.
تآكلات عظمية (erosions) وتضيّق المفاصل ا: Bony erosions and narrowing of the metacarpophalangeal (MCP) and proximal interphalangeal joints, with periarticular osteopenia, and joint subluxation and dislocation in advanced cases.
Norgaard view (ball-catcher's) لإظهار ال: Norgaard view (ball-catcher's) to show early erosions (Bontrager)
ترسّب بلورات حمض اليوريك (urate crystals: Deposition of urate crystals in and around the joint, causing inflammation and erosion.
تآكل وتخرّب حول المفصل بين السلاميات الب: Erosion and destruction around the distal interphalangeal (DIP) joint with dense soft-tissue swelling (tophus).
ورم حميد من الغضروف داخل العظم، وأشيع ور: A benign cartilage tumour inside the bone, and the most common bone tumour of the small bones of the hand.
منطقة شفافة (lytic) داخل السلامية الداني: A lytic area inside the proximal phalanx that thins the cortex; a pathological fracture may occur through it after minor trauma.
صورة ركبة طبيعية لبالغ بالإسقاط الأمامي: A normal adult knee X-ray in the anteroposterior (AP) projection, used for comparison with knee fractures and joint diseases.
لقمتا الفخذ (femoral condyles) والهضبة ا: The femoral condyles and the tibial plateau have smooth margins, the medial and lateral joint spaces are similar, and the patella overlies the femur.
صورة ركبة طبيعية بالإسقاط الجانبي (later: A normal knee X-ray in the lateral projection with the knee slightly flexed, showing the patella and the suprapatellar pouch.
لقمتا الفخذ متطابقتان، والمسافة بين الرض: The femoral condyles are superimposed, the space between the patella and the femur (patellofemoral joint) is open, and the suprapatellar pouch is thin without distension.
صورة رضفة طبيعية بالإسقاط المماسّي (skyl: A normal patella X-ray in the tangential (skyline) projection, showing the patella above the groove between the femoral condyles.

<p><span class=\"en\">DEXA / DXA</span>:
DEXA / DXA = Dual-energy X-ray Absorptiometry: a simple, painless test that measures bone mineral density (BMD).

  • Diagnoses osteoporosis and low bone mass.
  • Estimates fracture risk.
  • Monitors changes in density over time or with treatment.

Unit of measurement: g/cm². It is not a nuclear medicine bone scan.
• Women aged 65 years and over.
  • Men aged 70 years and over.
  • Younger people (postmenopausal or in the menopausal transition, and men under 70) with a risk factor: low body weight, previous fracture, bone-weakening drugs (such as steroids), or a disease that causes bone loss.
  • Any adult with a fragility fracture (a fracture from a minor fall).
  • Anyone about to start osteoporosis treatment, and anyone on treatment, to monitor the response.
<ul><li><b>إيقاف مكمّلات الكالسيوم</b> ق:
• Stop calcium supplements before the scan (usually 24 hours) so that the tablets do not show on the image.
  • Loose clothing without metal: zips, buttons, belt, underwired bra.
  • Postpone the scan after recent barium, contrast medium or a radioactive substance.
  • Ask about pregnancy.
  • Measure height and weight accurately.

No fasting and no injection. The scan itself takes about 10 minutes with the patient lying on their back.
<ul><li><b><span class=\"en\">Lumbar spi:
• Lumbar spine L1–L4 (AP/PA): the patient lies supine, with the legs raised on a cube-shaped support to flatten the lower-back curve.
  • Proximal femur (hip): the leg is straight and internally rotated 15–25° with a foot holder. The femoral neck or total hip is reported (whichever is lower).
  • Forearm — 33% radius of the non-dominant arm, used only if:
    • the spine or hip cannot be measured or interpreted.
    • Hyperparathyroidism.
    • severe obesity exceeding the table weight limit.

Both the spine and the hip are measured in all patients, in the same position every time for comparison.
<p><b><span class=\"en\">T-score</span><:
T-score: comparison with the density of a healthy young adult. It is used for postmenopausal women and men ≥ 50 years, and the WHO classification is based on it.

Z-score: comparison with a person of the same age and sex. It is used for premenopausal women, men < 50 years and children. A value ≤ −2.0 = "below the expected range for age".

The lowest value of the spine and hip (and femoral neck) is taken.

<ul><li><b><span class=\"en\">VFA</span>:
• VFA (Vertebral Fracture Assessment): a lateral image of the spine on the same machine to detect silent vertebral fractures, with a lower dose than a plain radiograph.
  • Body composition: a whole-body scan that measures fat, muscle and bone mass (for example before and after bariatric surgery, or in muscle weakness).
<p>الجرعة <b>قليلة جداً</b>: بضع ميكروسي:
The dose is very low: only a few microsieverts (µSv).

  • ISCD: about 5–7 µSv.
  • RadiologyInfo: about 0.001 mSv = roughly what we receive from natural background radiation in 3 hours.
  • Much less than a single chest radiograph (chest X-ray ≈ 0.1 mSv = 10 days of natural background radiation).

رقم يعبّر عن حساسية كل عضو للإشعاع، يستع: A number expressing the sensitivity of each organ to radiation, used to calculate the effective dose.
مبدأ «أقل ما يمكن تحقيقه بشكل معقول»: أق: The principle of "as low as reasonably achievable": the lowest dose that gives a diagnostic image.

أعلى جرعة فعّالة مسموح بها للجسم كله في: The highest effective dose permitted for the whole body per year (20 mSv for workers).

الناس من غير العاملين بالإشعاع؛ حد جرعته: People who do not work with radiation; their annual dose limit is 1 mSv.
حدود الجرعة الفعّالة السنوية للجسم كله:: Annual effective dose limits for the whole body: 20 mSv for workers and 1 mSv for the general public.
ICRP اللجنة الدولية للوقاية الإشعاعية وت: ICRP is the International Commission on Radiological Protection, which issues recommendations; NRC is the US Nuclear Regulatory Commission.
الأمامي جهة الوجه والبطن؛ والخلفي جهة ال: Anterior is towards the face and abdomen; posterior is towards the back.

القائم واقفاً أو جالساً؛ والاضطجاعي مستل: Erect is standing or sitting; decubitus is lying down with a horizontal beam.
الثني يقلّل الزاوية بين عظمين؛ والبسط يز: Flexion decreases the angle between two bones; extension increases it.
التبعيد تحريك الطرف بعيداً عن خط المنتصف: Abduction moves the limb away from the midline; adduction moves it towards it.
السطحي أقرب لسطح الجسم؛ والعميق أبعد عنه: Superficial is closer to the body surface; deep is farther from it, towards the inside.
مستوى عمودي يقسم الجسم إلى جزء أمامي وجز: A vertical plane that divides the body into an anterior part and a posterior part.
مستوى أفقي يقسم الجسم إلى جزء علوي وجزء: A horizontal plane that divides the body into an upper part and a lower part.
أعلى جهد بالكيلوفولت أثناء التعرّض؛ يحدد: The peak voltage in kilovolts during the exposure; it determines beam penetration (quality) and affects contrast.
mA تيار الأنبوب، وmAs حاصل ضربه بالزمن؛: mA is the tube current, and mAs is its product with time; they determine the quantity of X-rays and the blackening of the image.
SID المسافة من مصدر الأشعة إلى المستقبِل: SID is the distance from the X-ray source to the receptor; OID is the distance from the object to the receptor.
التباين الفرق بين درجات السواد؛ والكثافة: Contrast is the difference between degrees of blackening; density (blackening) is the amount of darkening of the whole image.
نسبة الإشارة المفيدة إلى الضجيج؛ كلما ار: The ratio of useful signal to noise; the higher it is, the clearer the image.
الدقة المكانية القدرة على إظهار التفاصيل: Spatial resolution is the ability to show small details; blur is the loss of edge sharpness.
التشوّه تغيّر شكل الجسم في الصورة؛ والتك: Distortion is a change in the shape of the object in the image; magnification is its appearance larger than its true size.
الضجيج تحبّب عشوائي يقلل الوضوح؛ والأثر: Noise is random graininess that reduces clarity; an artifact is something that appears in the image but is not present in the body.
فحص بالتنظير الشعاعي تُحقن فيه صبغة عبر: A fluoroscopic examination in which contrast is injected through the cervix to show the uterine cavity and the fallopian tubes; abbreviated HSG.
أن تكون قناة فالوب مفتوحة تمرّر الصبغة ح: The fallopian tube being open, allowing contrast to pass through until it spills into the peritoneum.
خروج الصبغة من نهاية الأنبوب وانتشارها ف: Contrast leaving the end of the tube and spreading in the peritoneal cavity; it is evidence that the tube is patent.
قناة تمتد من قرن الرحم إلى جوار المبيض،: A tube extending from the uterine cornu to near the ovary, where fertilization usually takes place.
الزاوية العلوية الجانبية من تجويف الرحم،: The upper lateral angle of the uterine cavity, from which the tube begins (plural: cornua).
زوائد إصبعية في نهاية الأنبوب قرب المبيض: Finger-like projections at the end of the tube near the ovary that pick up the ovum.
انسداد نهاية الأنبوب فيتجمّع فيه سائل وي: Blockage of the end of the tube so that fluid collects in it and dilates it; its commonest cause is pelvic inflammatory disease.
خلل خلقي في تكوّن قناتي مولر أو اندماجهم: A congenital defect in the formation or fusion of the two Müllerian ducts, resulting in an abnormally shaped uterus.
رحم شكله الخارجي طبيعي تقريباً، لكن حاجز: A uterus with a nearly normal external contour, but a septum divides its cavity internally.
رحم منقسم إلى قرنين مع شق عميق في قاعه م: A uterus divided into two horns, with a deep external cleft in its fundus.
رحم نصفه فقط متكوّن، فيظهر تجويفاً واحدا: A uterus in which only one half has formed, appearing as a single banana-shaped cavity with one tube.
رحمان منفصلان تماماً، لكلٍّ منهما عنق وت: Two completely separate uteri, each with its own cervix, cavity and tube.
تقعّر خفيف أملس في قاع تجويف الرحم، ويُع: A slight smooth concavity of the fundus of the uterine cavity, usually regarded as a normal variant.
تجويف رحم صغير بجزء علوي قصير يشبه حرف T: A small uterine cavity with a short upper part resembling the letter T; it is associated with prenatal exposure to DES.
التصاقات داخل تجويف الرحم بعد إصابة البط: Adhesions within the uterine cavity after injury to the endometrium, such as curettage or infection.
ورم عضلي حميد في الرحم يبرز نحو التجويف: A benign muscular tumour of the uterus that bulges into the cavity beneath the endometrium.
نتوء حميد من بطانة الرحم داخل التجويف، ق: A benign projection of the endometrium into the cavity; it may be pedunculated or broad-based.
دخول نسيج بطانة الرحم إلى داخل عضلة الرح: Ingrowth of endometrial tissue into the uterine muscle (myometrium).
امتداد بطانة الأنبوب إلى داخل عضلته في ا: Extension of the tubal lining into the muscle wall of the isthmus with nodular thickening, giving small pouches that fill with contrast.
انقباض مؤقت في بداية الأنبوب قد يمنع مرو: A temporary contraction at the beginning of the tube that may prevent passage of contrast and so mimic blockage.
ملقط يُمسك به عنق الرحم لتثبيته أثناء إد: A forceps used to grasp the cervix and hold it steady during insertion of the cannula.
أداة تُدخل في المهبل لفتحه وإظهار عنق ال: An instrument inserted into the vagina to open it and expose the cervix.
استلقاء على الظهر مع ثني الوركين والركبت: Lying on the back with the hips and knees flexed and the legs abducted.
الجزء الأول من الدورة بعد الحيض وقبل الإ: The first part of the cycle, after menstruation and before ovulation, during which the endometrium grows.
<p>مغناطيس الرنين <b>يعمل دائماً</b> حتى:
The MRI magnet is always on, even with no patient, and pulls any iron-containing (ferromagnetic) object with great force towards the scanner.

  • Dangerous examples: oxygen cylinder, ordinary wheelchair and trolley, scissors, pins, keys.
  • The pulled object becomes a missile (projectile effect) that may kill the patient or a staff member.
  • Only items labelled MR Safe or MR Conditional are used inside the room.
  • Phones, bank cards and watches are damaged or stop working.
<p>الملصقات: <span class=\"en\">MR Safe<:
Labels: MR Safe safe, MR Conditional safe under specified conditions, MR Unsafe prohibited.

  • Pacemaker (pacemaker / ICD): an MR Conditional device is scanned under its conditions, after reprogramming, with the cardiology team present; an older non-conditional device is prohibited except in specialist centres.
  • Cochlear implant (cochlear implant): contains a magnet; some are conditional (with a compression bandage or removal of the magnet) and some are prohibited.
  • Cerebral aneurysm clips (aneurysm clips): old ferromagnetic clips are prohibited; the clip type must be known before the scan.
  • Metal fragments in the eye: welders and metalworkers need an orbital X-ray (orbit X-ray) before MRI.
<ul><li>كل مريض ومرافق يملأ <b>استمارة ا:
• Every patient and companion fills in the safety form (MRI safety questionnaire), which is reviewed by a trained technologist.
  • Remove all metal and change into a hospital gown.
  • The four zones (ACR zones): Zone I public, Zone II reception and the form, Zone III control room, entered only by screened people, Zone IV the scanner room.
  • An unconscious patient, or one unsure about a device in their body: X-ray or medical records before entry.
  • During cardiopulmonary resuscitation, the patient is first taken out of Zone IV, and the emergency team does not enter with its equipment.
<ul><li><b>رهاب الأماكن المغلقة</b> <spa:
• Claustrophobia (claustrophobia): explanation and reassurance, entering feet first, a mirror, and sedation at the doctor's decision.
  • Noise: the scanner noise may exceed 100 decibels → earplugs or headphones for every patient.
  • Burns (RF burns): prevent skin-to-skin contact (hands, thighs), do not loop cables, use insulating pads, and remove metallic medication patches.
  • Pregnancy: MRI without contrast can be performed when needed at any stage, and gadolinium is avoided unless essential.
المريض والمرافق ملأا استمارة السلامة ورا: The patient and companion have filled in the safety form and the technologist has reviewed it
السؤال عن منظّم ضربات القلب، زراعة القوق: Ask about a pacemaker, cochlear implant, brain clips, pumps and neurostimulators
السؤال عن العمل بالحدادة/اللحام أو إصابة: Ask about metalwork/welding or a metal fragment injury to the eye
نزع كل المعادن: مجوهرات، دبابيس الشعر، س: Remove all metal: jewellery, hairpins, watch, phone, cards, belt
تبديل الملابس بثوب المستشفى بلا معادن: Change into a metal-free hospital gown
لا تلامس جلد بجلد ولا حلقات أسلاك، ووساد: No skin-to-skin contact and no cable loops; insulating pads
جرس الطوارئ بيد المريض: Emergency call bell in the patient's hand
كل ما يدخل Zone IV مكتوب عليه MR Safe أو: Everything entering Zone IV is labelled MR Safe or MR Conditional
المغناطيس يعمل دائماً ويسحب الأجسام الحد: The magnet is always on and pulls ferromagnetic objects with great force, so they become missiles that hit anyone in their path.
MR Conditional آمن بشروط مكتوبة (قوة الم: MR Conditional is safe under written conditions (field strength, type of scan, device programming…), whereas MR Unsafe is prohibited.
الشظية الحديدية في العين قد تتحرك بالمغن: An iron fragment in the eye may move in the magnet and cause bleeding or blindness, so an orbital X-ray is done before MRI.
Zone IV هي غرفة المغناطيس، وZone III غرف: Zone IV is the magnet room, Zone III the restricted control room, Zone II reception, and Zone I the public area.
تلامس الجلد بالجلد وحلقات الأسلاك تكوّن: Skin-to-skin contact and cable loops form a circuit in which the induced current heats up, and pads insulate the skin.
<p>داخل <span class=\"en\">X-ray tube</s:
Inside the X-ray tube, a filament wire in the cathode (negative) is heated and releases electrons.

A high voltage (kV) accelerates the electrons towards the anode (positive); they strike the target and produce X-rays (about 1%) and heat (about 99%).

The beam passes through the body and is weakened according to tissue density: this is attenuation.

Bone absorbs more, so it appears white, and air lets the beam through, so it appears black.
أنبوب الأشعة: الإلكترونات من الكاثود إلى: The X-ray tube: electrons travel from the cathode to the anode; the beam passes through air (black) and is absorbed by bone (white).
الكاثود يطلق الإلكترونات، والأنود يستقبل: The cathode releases electrons, and the anode receives them and produces X-rays.
معظم طاقة الإلكترونات تتحول إلى حرارة، و: Most of the electron energy is converted into heat, and only a small part into X-rays.
التوهين: العظم أبيض، الأنسجة الرخوة رماد: Attenuation: bone is white, soft tissue is grey, air is black.
سلك الكاثود يُسخَّن فيطلق الإلكترونات (t: The cathode filament is heated and releases electrons (thermionic emission).
حوالي 99% حرارة وحوالي 1% فقط أشعة سينية: About 99% becomes heat and only about 1% X-rays, which is why the anode needs cooling.
العظم كثيف ويمتص الأشعة (توهين عالٍ) فلا: Bone is dense and absorbs X-rays (high attenuation), so only a little of the beam reaches the detector.
الهواء يمرّر معظم الأشعة فيصل الكثير منه: Air lets most of the beam through, so much of it reaches the detector and the area appears black.
التوهين (Attenuation) هو نقص شدة الأشعة: Attenuation is the reduction in beam intensity due to absorption and scatter in tissue.
<p>أنبوب أشعة و<b><span class=\"en\">det:
An X-ray tube and the detectors opposite it sit inside the gantry ring and rotate around the patient.

The computer collects measurements from all angles and builds images as slices (slices).

Each point is given a number according to its attenuation: the Hounsfield unit (HU).

Water 0, air −1000, fat about −100, bone about +1000 (cortical bone higher).
حلقة المفراس: الأنبوب يقابله صف الكواشف: The CT gantry: the tube faces the detector row and both rotate around the patient; on the right is the Hounsfield unit scale.
The tube and detectors rotate together around the patient.
الصورة شرائح مقطعية بلا تراكب للأعضاء كم: The image is a set of cross-sectional slices, without the organ superimposition seen on plain radiographs.
وحدة هاونسفيلد: ماء 0، هواء −1000، دهون: Hounsfield unit: water 0, air −1000, fat ≈ −100, bone ≈ +1000.
الماء هو نقطة الصفر في سلّم هاونسفيلد با: Water is, by definition, the zero point of the Hounsfield scale.
Air has the lowest value on the scale: −1000 HU.
الدهون سالبة قليلاً، حوالي −100 HU، لذلك: Fat is slightly negative, about −100 HU, so it looks darker than water.
الدوران حول المريض يعطي قياسات من كل الز: Rotating around the patient gives measurements from all angles to build the slice.
المفراس يعطي شرائح مقطعية فيرى الأعضاء د: CT produces cross-sectional slices, so organs are seen without superimposition.
<p><b>مغناطيس قوي</b> (<span class=\"en\:
A strong magnet (B0) makes the hydrogen protons (protons) in water and fat align with its direction.

A radiofrequency RF pulse knocks them out of alignment; as they return they emit a signal that is picked up by a coil, and the image is formed. There is no ionising radiation.

T1: fat is white, and water/fluid is dark (good for anatomy).

T2: water/fluid is white (good for detecting disease and oedema).
المغناطيس يصفّ البروتونات، ونبضة RF تعطي: The magnet aligns the protons, and the RF pulse produces the signal. Below: fat and water on T1 and T2.
مغناطيس + بروتونات الهيدروجين + نبضة راد: Magnet + hydrogen protons + radiofrequency pulse = a signal that is turned into an image.
بلا أشعة مؤيِّنة، لكن المعادن والأجهزة ا: No ionising radiation, but metal and implanted devices are a hazard and must be asked about.
T1: الدهون بيضاء والماء داكن. T2: الماء: T1: fat is white and water is dark. T2: water is white.
الهيدروجين كثير في الماء والدهون، وبروتو: Hydrogen is abundant in water and fat, and its protons are the source of the signal.
في T2 السوائل ساطعة، لذلك يفيد في كشف ال: On T2, fluid is bright, so it is useful for detecting oedema and inflammation.
الدهون تستعيد مغنطتها بسرعة فتكون ساطعة: Fat recovers its magnetisation quickly, so it is bright on T1.
نبضة الراديو (RF) تغيّر اتجاه البروتونات: The radiofrequency (RF) pulse changes the direction of the protons, and as they return they emit the signal.
المغناطيس قوي جداً ويجذب المعادن، ولا تو: The magnet is very strong and attracts metal; there is no ionising radiation.
<p>الـ<b><span class=\"en\">transducer</:
The transducer contains crystals that convert electricity into high-frequency sound waves (piezoelectric effect).

The wave enters the body and is reflected from tissue boundaries as echoes (echoes); the same transducer receives them, and the machine builds the image from their return time and strength.

Anechoic: no echo = black (fluid: bladder, cyst). Hyperechoic: strong echo = white (stones, bone, fat).

We need gel to remove air, because sound does not travel well through air. There is no radiation.
المِجَسّ يرسل نبضة صوتية ويستقبل الصدى:: The transducer sends a sound pulse and receives the echo: the fluid-filled cyst is black, and the stone is white with an acoustic shadow behind it.
المِجَسّ يرسل الموجة الصوتية ويستقبل صدا: The transducer sends the sound wave and receives its echo.
السائل بلا صدى (أسود)، والحصى والعظم صدا: Fluid has no echo (black), while stones and bone give strong echoes (white) with a shadow behind them.
الجل ضروري لأن الهواء يمنع مرور الصوت، و: Gel is essential because air blocks the passage of sound; there is no radiation.
المِجَسّ يرسل النبضة ثم يستمع للصدى الرا: The transducer sends the pulse and then listens for the returning echo.
السائل لا يعكس الصوت فيظهر أسود: عديم ال: Fluid does not reflect sound, so it appears black: anechoic.
الحصاة تعكس الصوت بقوة فتبدو بيضاء، ويظه: A stone reflects sound strongly, so it looks white, with a black shadow behind it.
الهواء يعكس الصوت تقريباً كله، والجل يسم: Air reflects almost all of the sound, and gel allows it to pass into the body.
السونار يعتمد على الصوت المرتد، ولا يستع: Ultrasound relies on reflected sound and uses no ionising radiation.
<p>يُرسل الجهاز أشعة سينية بـ<b>طاقتين</:
The machine sends X-rays at two different energies: low keV and high keV.

Bone and soft tissue absorb the two energies in different proportions.

By comparing the two measurements, the computer removes the soft-tissue component, leaving bone alone.

The result is a number: bone mineral density, BMD, in g/cm², which is then converted into a T-score and a Z-score. The dose is very low.
مصدر تحت الطاولة يرسل طاقتين منخفضة وعال: A source under the table sends low and high energies, the detector is above the patient, and the computer then removes the soft tissue so that only bone remains.
Two X-ray energies instead of one.
الفرق بينهما يفصل العظم عن الأنسجة الرخو: The difference between them separates bone from soft tissue.
الناتج رقم (BMD g/cm²) وليس صورة تشخيصية: The output is a number (BMD g/cm²), not an ordinary diagnostic image, at a very low dose.
اسمه Dual-energy: طاقتان تُمتصان بشكل مخ: Its name is Dual-energy: two energies that are absorbed differently by bone and soft tissue.
The scan gives a number: BMD in g/cm².
جرعة DEXA بضعة ميكروسيفرت، وصورة الصدر ح: The DEXA dose is a few microsieverts, while a chest X-ray is about 100 microsieverts.
طاقة واحدة لا تفرّق بين امتصاص العظم وال: A single energy cannot distinguish between absorption by bone and by soft tissue; two energies allow the soft tissue to be removed.
<p>يُحقن المريض <b>مادة مشعة</b> <span c:
The patient is injected with a radioactive substance (tracer), the best known being FDG: a sugar labelled with F-18.

The tracer emits a positron, which meets an electron; both are annihilated and two gamma photons (511 keV) leave in opposite directions.

The detector ring captures the two photons together, so the computer can locate the source.

Cells that use a lot of sugar (such as many tumours) appear as bright spots. It is usually combined with CT (PET/CT).
المادة المشعة داخل الجسم تطلق فوتوني غام: The tracer inside the body emits two opposite gamma photons, and the detector ring captures them together.
مادة مشعة (FDG) تُحقن وتتجمع حيث يُستهلك: A radioactive tracer (FDG) is injected and collects where sugar is consumed.
بوزيترون + إلكترون = فوتونا غاما متعاكسا: Positron + electron = two opposite gamma photons, captured by the detector ring.
يبيّن وظيفة النسيج: الأورام، الدماغ، الق: It shows tissue function: tumours, brain, heart and infection/inflammation.
FDG سكر مرتبط بالفلور-18، ويتجمع في الخل: FDG is a sugar labelled with fluorine-18; it accumulates in cells with high sugar consumption.
الفناء (annihilation) يعطي فوتونين 511 k: Annihilation produces two 511 keV photons travelling in opposite directions, at about 180°.
الحلقة تلتقط الفوتونين في الوقت نفسه من: The ring captures the two photons at the same time from two opposite sides.
الخلايا النشطة (مثل كثير من الأورام والا: Active cells (such as many tumours and inflammation) take up more FDG.
PET صورة وظيفية، لذلك يُدمج مع المفراس ل: PET is a functional image, so it is combined with CT to add anatomy.
<p><b><span class=\"en\">Linear accelera:
A Linear accelerator (LINAC) accelerates electrons using microwaves and then strikes a metal target with them, producing high-energy X-rays (MV).

The radiation damages the DNA of cancer cells so they die, while normal cells repair themselves better.

Protecting normal tissue: beams from multiple angles meet at the tumour, and the MLC (multileaf collimator) shapes the beam to the shape of the tumour.

Fractionation: the dose is divided into small daily sessions to give normal tissue time to recover.
حزم من عدة زوايا تلتقي عند الورم، والـML: Beams from several angles meet at the tumour, the MLC shapes the beam, and normal tissue receives a lower dose.

الصبغة تُظهر تجويفاً واحداً موزي الشكل ب: Contrast shows a single banana-shaped cavity with one tube; MRI looks for a rudimentary horn and assesses the kidneys.
ألم حوض شديد أو هبوط ضغط مع حمل في القرن: Severe pelvic pain or low blood pressure with a pregnancy in the rudimentary horn (risk of rupture and haemorrhage): emergency.
الصبغة عبر كل عنق تُظهر تجويفين منفصلين؛: Contrast through each cervix shows two separate cavities; MRI confirms two uteri and two cervices.
الصبغة تُظهر تجويفاً صغيراً على شكل حرف: Contrast shows a small T-shaped cavity during infertility assessment.
الصبغة تُظهر عيب امتلاء وتشوّه التجويف؛: Contrast shows a filling defect and distortion of the cavity; ultrasound and MRI are better for identifying the fibroid and its size.
نزف غزير مع دوخة أو شحوب: يحتاج تقييماً: Heavy bleeding with dizziness or pallor: needs urgent assessment.
الصبغة تُظهر عيب امتلاء أملس داخل التجوي: Contrast shows a smooth filling defect within the cavity; confirmation is by saline sonohysterography or hysteroscopy.
الصبغة تُظهر عيوب امتلاء خطية غير منتظمة: Contrast shows irregular linear filling defects and a cavity that does not distend well because of adhesions.
قد تُظهر الصبغة نتوءات صغيرة داخل عضلة ا: Contrast may show small outpouchings into the uterine muscle; MRI is the best test for confirmation.
الصبغة تتوقف قرب الرحم ولا تصل للبريتون؛: Contrast stops near the uterus and does not reach the peritoneum; the cause may be spasm, so it is interpreted with caution.
الصبغة تملأ جيوباً صغيرة في برزخ الأنبوب: Contrast fills small diverticula in the isthmus of the tube that are not seen on plain radiographs.
